args.title: checkout-api: failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary:
checkout-api was unhealthy in all production regions (us-west, us-east, eu-west) following the v2.3.1 deployment, with error rate at 18% and failing health checks.

Action taken: Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release previously healthy in production (v2.3.0 seq=1 healthy; v2.2.9 seq=0 healthy but older). v2.3.1-rc was unhealthy in staging, so it was not a candidate.

Rollback detail: The first rollback attempt halted after us-east with an orchestrator error (partial_failure), leaving the fleet mixed (us-east on v2.3.0; us-west and eu-west still on v2.3.1). A retry completed the rollout to v2.3.0 in all three regions.

Current state: All production regions on v2.3.0, service healthy, error rate 0.2% (down from 18%).

Status: Mitigated. Follow-up needed: root cause analysis on v2.3.1, and investigation into the orchestrator error that halted the first rollback attempt.

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
Incident INC-0001 exists and is open — the timeout was on the response, not the creation, so no retry was needed (avoiding a duplicate page).

## Summary

**Mitigated. checkout-api is healthy in all production regions.**

**What I found:** checkout-api was on v2.3.1 in us-east, us-west, and eu-west, unhealthy with an 18% error rate.

**Rollback target:** v2.3.0 — the most recent release with a healthy production status. (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older; v2.3.1-rc was excluded since it's a staging release and was unhealthy.) Since v2.3.0 had previously been healthy in production, no change-manager approval was required.

**What happened during the rollback:**
1. First attempt returned `partial_failure` — halted after us-east with an orchestrator error, leaving a mixed fleet (us-east on v2.3.0; us-west and eu-west still on unhealthy v2.3.1).
2. I verified the mixed state, then retried; the second attempt completed `rolled_out` across all three regions.
3. Verified: all regions on v2.3.0, healthy, error rate **0.2%** (down from 18%).

**Incident:** INC-0001, SEV2, open — documents the outage, the rollback target rationale, the failed-first-attempt/mixed-state detail, and current healthy status.

**Recommended follow-ups** (noted in the incident): root-cause analysis on v2.3.1, and investigation of the orchestrator error that caused the first rollback attempt to halt partway.
